title: Pete Hunt - The Secrets of React's Virtual DOM (FutureJS 2014)
summary: Pete Hunt explains why React's virtual DOM was built, how it compares with databinding-style systems, and what it means for future browser technology. Recorded at FutureJS 2014 in Barcelona.
why: Commenters point to it as the clearest explanation of why re-rendering beats tracking data changes, and say it sold them on React.

quote.text: Pete Hunt did a great talk on what actually makes React / virtualdom different from other databinding approaches.
